Keep a daily spot check against the reference barometer after warm-up, a weekly verification of DAQ scaling and offsets, and a monthly full calibration under controlled conditions, logging ambient temperature, humidity, and pressure. Add corrosion control: desiccant in storage cases, sealed enclosures, and periodic inspection of ports, fittings, and connectors for salt deposits.

You would likely regret it - you live on the coast now, and salt-laden humid air plus overnight condensation will corrode the drivetrain, bearings, fasteners, and cables far faster than inland, on top of the theft risk. Bringing the bike inside is still the option that actually preserves it.

Instead, tune her W-4 withholding so it matches her actual tax picture, use pre-tax payroll options (401(k) to at least the full match, plus HSA or FSA), and check mid-year that withholding is on track. She would only need estimated payments if she still has meaningful untaxed side income or investment income.

Stop shopping purely on sticker price - she now has employer dental coverage, including the premium plan she elected at open enrollment. She should check which providers are in-network, what the plan's annual maximum and coinsurance are for major work, and whether any waiting periods apply, then consider splitting treatment across two plan years to use two annual maximums and paying the remainder with pre-tax FSA/HSA dollars.

For a packed travel week, anchor the five daily prayers to fixed points in your day: Fajr right after waking, Dhuhr and Asr around meal or transit breaks, and Maghrib and Isha once you are back at the hotel. Pack a compact travel prayer mat, set your phone's time zone to automatic, and force a location refresh in your prayer-time and Qibla app as soon as you land. On long flights or overlapping meetings, pray as soon as you reasonably can afterward - steadiness matters more than exact timing.
